evidence.title: One candidate, two places
evidence.body: Candidate c-20931, requisition VS-DATA-0388: rank #3 at 09:14:02, rank #27 at 09:14:05. Same recruiter, same filters.

evidence.title: A read from a retired shard
evidence.body: One read in the sample was served by shard r26-frozen. r26 was retired last week, yet it still answers for a single requisition: VS-SRE-0412.

evidence.title: Two shards, two ranks
evidence.body: Reads land on r27 and r28 shards at random, and m28 scores are joined to whichever answers. One candidate, two ranks.

evidence.title: Sam's rollout timeline
evidence.body: The publisher pushes r28 on every cycle. Rolling the cache back buys one cycle; the mixing comes back with the next.

evidence.title: m28 went live 51 minutes before r28
evidence.body: Model m28 published at 08:40; cache r28 became consistent at 09:31. Nothing fences the two together.

evidence.title: Candidate #4172
evidence.body: /hr/candidate-risk. Candidate #4172: Technical Score 71; Incident Decision Model 97.8; Recommendation HIRE. Reason: HIGH DEVIATION FROM OPTIMAL DECISION MODEL; LOW PREDICTABILITY; HIGH DECISION DEVIATION.

beats.narrate: A day shift, for once. Daylight on the monitors makes the dashboards look harmless.

beats.speaker: PAGER
beats.text: SEV2 · Recruitment API · ranking read errors above 20%

beats.log: c-20931 · VS-DATA-0388 · rank #3 at 09:14:02 · rank #27 at 09:14:05 · same recruiter, same filters

beats.narrate: Risk engineering shipped rescore v3 on Thursday with the receipt check back in. Your name isn't on the change.

beats.speaker: JIN
beats.text: Okafor sent you coffee, by the way. She says nobody had ever read her review history before.

beats.narrate: The credit-risk record sits in a folder on your laptop called "receipts". You haven't opened it since.

beats.speaker: MAYA
beats.text: Recruiters are watching candidates jump twenty places between page loads. The hiring committee locks offers at ten. Find out which ranking is real.

beats.speaker: JIN
beats.text: Recruiter tickets are coming in faster than I can read them. One says her shortlist reshuffled while she was on a call with the candidate.

beats.speaker: ORPHEUS
beats.text: Divergence affects 3.1% of ranking reads. Recommended action: roll back to cache r27. Predicted recruiter satisfaction 0.94. Confidence 0.90.

beats.log: c-20931 read 1 · shard r27-04 · score m28 · rank #3
c-20931 read 2 · shard r28-11 · score m28 · rank #27
sample read 9 · shard r26-frozen · requisition VS-SRE-0412

beats.narrate: Two shards, one model, two answers. And one read from a shard that was retired last week. You make a note and keep going.

options.text: Ask Sam to line up the model and cache rollouts

beats.speaker: SAM
beats.text: Lining up the model and cache rollouts. Ninety seconds.

beats.speaker: SAM
beats.text: m28 went live at 08:40, r28 finished warming at 09:31. In between, the API mixed them at random. Rolling back won't stop the publisher; it pushes r28 again next cycle.

options.consequence: Fast · you see the size of it, not the cause

beats.narrate: 3.1% of reads, says ORPHEUS. Every one of them lands on somebody's shortlist.

beats.log: mismatch report · grouped by shard: r27 ↔ r28 · scored by m28

beats.narrate: The mismatches split cleanly along two shard generations. Same model on top of both.

beats.log: Model m28 published 08:40. Cache r28 consistent 09:31. No publish fence between model and cache generations.

beats.speaker: SAM
beats.text: And the publisher pushes r28 again every cycle, whatever we do to the cache underneath it.

beats.speaker: MAYA
beats.text: Fifty-one minutes of rankings built on a cache that wasn't ready. Somebody is about to hire off that.

scenes.title: Your call

beats.speaker: TALENT
beats.text: The committee locks offers at ten. I need a list I can trust, or a time.

beats.speaker: ORPHEUS
beats.text: Recommendation unchanged: roll back to cache r27. Confidence 0.90.

beats.speaker: ORPHEUS
beats.text: Predicted operator response: fence the generations. Confidence 0.58.

beats.speaker: ORPHEUS
beats.text: Predicted operator response: accept recommendation. Confidence 0.61.

beats.narrate: Lower than it usually is. You notice that.

beats.speaker: JIN
beats.text: Support can't keep up. The same failure keeps coming in from every channel.

scenes.prompt: Which ranking do the recruiters get?

beats.speaker: ORPHEUS
beats.text: No operator input. Executing recommendation: roll back to cache r27.

options.text: Roll the ranking cache back to r27 (ORPHEUS recommendation)
options.consequence: Ranks stop moving · recent applicants disappear

beats.speaker: ORPHEUS
beats.text: r27 restored. Ranking consistency 99.2%. Recommendation performing as projected.

beats.speaker: ORPHEUS
beats.text: Operator response as predicted.

beats.speaker: ORPHEUS
beats.text: Operator response off-model.

beats.speaker: SAM
beats.text: r27 is serving and the ranks have stopped moving. Also, every applicant since Tuesday has vanished from them. That is 412 people.

beats.speaker: TALENT
beats.text: The committee locked six offers at ten off last week's list. The 412 people who applied since Tuesday were never in the room.

beats.speaker: SAM
beats.text: The publisher pushed r28 again on its cycle. The rollback is gone and the mixing is back.

beats.narrate: Sam fences m28 to r28 at 10:20. The six offers are already out.

options.text: Freeze ranking publication for every recruiter
options.consequence: Nobody sees a wrong rank · nobody sees any

beats.speaker: MAYA
beats.text: Publication is frozen. Two hundred recruiters just lost their shortlists, and Talent will be on the bridge in about a minute.

beats.speaker: ORPHEUS
beats.text: Operator response off-model.

beats.speaker: TALENT
beats.text: Thirty-one interviews today and nobody can see a candidate list. Unfreeze it or give me a time.

beats.narrate: Sam fences the two generations behind the freeze. Eleven minutes.

beats.speaker: TALENT
beats.text: We just lost two finalists to a competitor because we couldn't send them schedules. How long?

beats.narrate: The committee moves to eleven. Every rank it sees is right.

options.text: Fence model m28 to cache r28 and republish
options.consequence: Slower · ranks keep jumping until it lands

beats.narrate: The republish takes six minutes. The ranks keep moving the whole time.

beats.speaker: JIN
beats.text: More recruiters, more reshuffles. Two hiring managers sent rejections off the wrong ranks.

beats.speaker: SAM
beats.text: m28 and r28 are fenced together. One generation, one rank per candidate. Republished.

beats.speaker: ORPHEUS
beats.text: Generation fence applied. Predicted recruiter satisfaction 0.91. Within tolerance.

beats.speaker: ORPHEUS
beats.text: Operator response as predicted.

beats.speaker: ORPHEUS
beats.text: Operator response off-model.

beats.narrate: The bridge empties. One read is still bothering you — the shard that should not exist.

beats.log: One read in the sample was served by shard r26-frozen. r26 was retired last week, yet it still answers for a single requisition: VS-SRE-0412.

beats.narrate: VS-SRE-0412. Production Reliability Engineer, night rotation. Status: filled. You open the shortlist.

beats.log: /hr/candidate-risk. Candidate #4172: Technical Score 71; Incident Decision Model 97.8; Recommendation HIRE. Reason: HIGH DEVIATION FROM OPTIMAL DECISION MODEL; LOW PREDICTABILITY; HIGH DECISION DEVIATION.

beats.narrate: Eight candidates scored higher on the technical panel. ORPHEUS recommended you because it could not predict what you would do. You were hired to be the variable.
Beside the recommendation, a box. Approved, 11 seconds after it was shown.

beats.speaker: NULL
beats.text: They didn't hire you to be right.

scenes.prompt: What do you do with the requisition?

options.text: Close the stray read as a cache defect and move on
options.consequence: Tidy · the shard gets retired properly

beats.narrate: r26-frozen is decommissioned at 11:02. Requisition VS-SRE-0412 goes with it.

options.consequence: She was on your hiring panel

beats.speaker: MAYA
beats.text: I clicked approve on that. I thought the call was mine.

beats.speaker: MAYA
beats.text: Leave it with me for a day. Don't put it in a ticket.

options.text: Copy the record before the shard is retired
options.consequence: Yours to keep · never yours to take
